claim: A criterion whose checker exists but produced no evidence in this run is recorded as not_observed — never as passed, and never dropped from the report.

steps.label: a run that exercised one of three declared criteria
steps.note: Nothing failed, and the run is not clean. Those are different statements, and only one of them is usually true.

steps.label: a run that exercised all three
recording a pass with no evidence behind it
steps.note: An assertion with nothing behind it is indistinguishable from not looking, right up until somebody asks what the evidence was.

steps.label: marking a criterion not_observed on purpose
steps.detail: not_observed is the absence of a record, not a record
steps.note: It is the absence of a record, not a record. Writing it deliberately would be worse than the gap it describes.

steps.label: two partial runs merged
steps.evidence: coverage accumulates; RS-003 is still unobserved

steps.label: two runs that disagree about the same criterion
steps.note: Refused rather than resolved. Picking a winner silently is how a flaky failure becomes a pass.
